extracted.intended_audience: short-story writers submitting fiction to One Story (literary magazine)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting a short story to One Story
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for writers preparing and submitting a single short story to the literary magazine One Story, including editorial quality expectations, technical submission requirements, and submission etiquette.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — single story, stand-alone issue
rubrics_metrics.description: One Story publishes ONE literary story every 3-4 weeks, mailed to subscribers. By design, each issue must stand alone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The chosen story should function as a complete, self-contained piece that can carry an entire issue on its own.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Standard — satisfying and stand-alone
rubrics_metrics.description: "Stories that leave readers feeling satisfied and are strong enough to stand alone."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on reader satisfaction and narrative completeness; the piece need not tie every thread but should feel earned and complete within itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word count requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions outside this range are not acceptable; select work that fits the specified length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and subject openness
rubrics_metrics.description: Any style, any subject "as long as they are good"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial taste governs selection; formal constraints are minimal beyond quality and fit with the single-story issue model.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously unpublished requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Previously unpublished (print outside North America OK)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should not have been published before; limited exception for print publication outside North America is allowed—check specifics if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and contributor copies
rubrics_metrics.description: $500 + 25 contributor copies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted pieces receive the stated payment and contributor copies; submission implies agreement to the magazine's contributor terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-contained narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-contained — the story doesn't require sequel/context
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The story should not rely on external pieces or implied sequels to deliver its primary impact; it must make sense and feel complete on its own.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfying ending
rubrics_metrics.description: Satisfying ending — resolution doesn't have to be tidy but feels earned
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Endings may be ambiguous or open, but must provide an emotional or thematic payoff consistent with the story's development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong voice — distinctive narrator/POV
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A clear, distinctive narrative voice or point of view that differentiates the story and engages the reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tight craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Tight craft — no filler; every scene matters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Economy of writing: scenes and details should serve the story's purpose; eliminate extraneous material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorability
rubrics_metrics.description: Memorable — sticks with the reader
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The story should leave a lasting impression, whether through image, insight, or emotional effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional truth
rubrics_metrics.description: Emotional truth — characters feel like real people in real predicaments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characters' emotions and reactions should feel authentic and credible within the story's context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read the magazine before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Read the magazine before submitting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Familiarize yourself with One Story's single-story format and editorial taste to determine fit and avoid mismatched submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit your strongest, most polished work
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your strongest, most polished work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors expect polished, submission-ready prose rather than drafts; prioritize revision before sending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow guidelines exactly
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow guidelines exactly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to submission specs (formatting, length, previously unpublished status, etc.); failing to follow guidelines can be grounds for exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send a clean, professional cover letter
rubrics_metrics.description: Send a clean, professional cover letter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep cover letters concise and professional; avoid unnecessary backstory or long biographies—focus on necessary metadata and courtesy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect stated response time
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't query about status before stated response time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait until the magazine's published response window has passed before asking about status to avoid annoying editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handle rejection professionally
rubrics_metrics.description: Take rejection professionally; consider personal notes seriously
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respond graciously to rejections; if an editor offers personalized feedback, treat it respectfully and consider it for revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Simultaneous submissions OK; notify on acceptance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple simultaneous submissions are permitted, but promptly inform One Story if the piece is accepted elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: No resubmission unless invited
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't resubmit unless explicitly invited
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send the same work again unless editors have asked for a resubmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep writing while you wait
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep writing while you wait
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain productivity and submit other work instead of awaiting a response; continual writing improves chances overall.
